amplitudeAttr.name: amplitude
amplitudeAttr.comment: the center-to-peak amplitude of the fractal noise

octavesAttr.name: octaves
octavesAttr.comment: the number of octaves of Fractal noise to be generated

lacunarityAttr.name: lacunarity
lacunarityAttr.comment: the exponential scale between successive octaves of Fractal noise

diminishAttr.name: diminish
diminishAttr.comment: the rate at which noise amplitude is diminished for each octave of Fractal noise

positionAttr.name: position
positionAttr.comment: the 3D position at which the fractal noise is evaluated
